title: English Usage · ขอบเขตและความหมาย

questions.subject: en
questions.question: “We may revisit the threshold after consultation.” Which report preserves the uncertainty?
questions.answer: The threshold could be reconsidered after consultation.
options: The threshold could be reconsidered after consultation.
The threshold will be changed immediately.
Consultation has already settled the threshold.
questions.explanation: “May” indicates a possibility, with consultation preceding any review.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which wording distinguishes an announced intention from implementation?
questions.answer: The agency announced plans to open a branch next year.
options: The agency announced plans to open a branch next year.
The agency has opened the branch.
The branch is already accepting applications.
questions.explanation: The first reports the announcement without stating that the branch exists.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which version links the comparison to a specific reference period?
questions.answer: The processing time was 15 percent lower than in the preceding quarter.
options: The processing time was 15 percent lower than in the preceding quarter.
The processing time was 15 percent lower than processing.
The processing time was lower by roughly a number.
questions.explanation: The first clearly names the measure and comparator.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: “Reports are required for grants exceeding $50,000.” Which grant is clearly covered?
options: $50,000 exactly

questions.subject: en
questions.question: “The approval expires unless the applicant meets the reporting deadline.” What is necessary to avoid expiry under this clause?
options: Meeting the reporting deadline
Ignoring the reporting deadline
Obtaining approval only after expiry
questions.explanation: “Unless” gives the condition under which expiry is avoided.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which sentence states that the agency can choose whether to act?
questions.answer: The agency may extend the period.
options: The agency may extend the period.
The agency shall extend the period.
The agency must extend the period.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which sentence shows an obligation rather than advice?
questions.answer: Applicants must provide the original document.
options: Applicants must provide the original document.
Applicants may provide the original document.
Applicants are encouraged to provide the original document.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: “The intervention was associated with shorter waits.” Which paraphrase preserves the evidence?
questions.answer: Shorter waits were linked to the intervention in the data.
options: Shorter waits were linked to the intervention in the data.
The intervention necessarily caused shorter waits.
Shorter waits caused the intervention to be introduced.
questions.explanation: An association does not alone identify a causal direction.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which sentence makes the scope of the exception explicit?
questions.answer: The reporting requirement applies to all branches except pilot sites.
options: The reporting requirement applies to all branches except pilot sites.
Except where possible, reporting requirements apply somehow.
All pilot sites and other branches are exempt.
questions.explanation: The first identifies the general rule and the exempt group.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Choose the phrase that flags an example rather than a complete list.
questions.answer: These measures include, for example, staff training.
options: These measures include, for example, staff training.
These measures consist exclusively of staff training.
The measures are limited to staff training alone.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which revision reports a correction transparently?
questions.answer: The total is 125; an earlier version incorrectly listed 152.
options: The total is 125; an earlier version incorrectly listed 152.
The earlier information was normal.
The total is different, as everyone probably knows.
questions.explanation: It identifies both the corrected figure and the previous error.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Which sentence accurately describes a draft whose approval is pending?
options: The draft is awaiting approval.
The draft has taken effect.
The draft was rejected permanently.
